BGU-CS-VIL/RF-DTAN @ 3e631ad (unmodified upstream, cloned 2026-10-21)
Single change (2026-10-21, for a fair comparison at equal embedding size d=128):
  models/RFDTAN.py: self.output_dim = 64  ->  kwargs.get("output_dim", 64)
Second change (2026-10-22): models/RFDTAN.py transform_grid: method="closed_form" ->
  os.environ.get("RFDTAN_GRAD", "closed_form"). On urania the difw C++/CUDA backends do not build
  (no Python.h; cpab_ops.cu fails with nvcc 12.4), and the pure-PyTorch closed-form gradient crashes
  for batched grids; RFDTAN_GRAD=numeric (difw numeric gradient) is used for runs that train the warp.
